categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Touches Guix toolchain definitions in `contrib/guix/` and `depends/` packages, and carries the 'Build system' label.
categories.rationale: Reduces non-GUI release binary size by trimming unused libstdc++ components from the Guix toolchain. Author measurements demonstrate ~0.48 MB size reductions across non-GUI binaries (e.g. bitcoind drops from 17.75 MB to 17.27 MB).

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Changes Guix release toolchains under `contrib/guix/`, which are build and release configurations rather than operator or developer command-line tools.
categories.rationale: The category explicitly excludes build and release scripts, which belong in build.
